PMFME Scheme Surpasses 2 Lakh Loan Sanctions, Creates Jobs

The Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme has achieved a significant milestone, surpassing 2 lakh loan sanctions. This initiative has reportedly generated employment for nearly 11 lakh individuals. The scheme aims to support micro food processing enterprises across the country.
